design_name: Task-conditioned partial-label multi-task borrowing local screen
claim_guard: This method was specified after earlier single-donor, bundle-concatenation, and SAFE residual-stack outcomes were inspected. It is method development only and requires a later frozen portfolio run plus outcome-unseen confirmation.
hypothesis: Neighbor datasets are more transferable when they train a task-conditioned shared representation from the union of partially labeled material-property pairs than when they are compressed to scalar donor predictions.

shared_expert.task_token: one-hot property identity concatenated to the common composition or Morgan representation
shared_expert.target_and_source_scaling: responses standardized separately inside each task
shared_expert.task_balance: each task contributes equal total sample weight
shared_expert.missing_labels: represented as separate observed material-property rows; no imputation
shared_expert.evaluation_identity_exclusion: all source-property rows matching a target evaluation identity are excluded
shared_expert.meta_fold_identity_exclusion: all source-property rows matching a held target meta-fold identity are excluded

safety_blend.objective: 0.5 * grouped out-of-fold all-sample MSE + 0.5 * pseudo-OOD upper-quartile MSE
safety_blend.fallback: blend = 0 recovers the target-only learner exactly

evaluation.escalation: bundle Q4 gain and Q4-minus-Q1 specificity exceed the wrong-source result, Q4 R2 is positive, and at least two learners benefit
